abstract: When tennis star Serena Williams disappeared from Instagram in early September 2017, her six million followers assumed they knew what had happened. Several months earlier, in March of that year, Williams had accidentally announced her pregnancy to the world via a bathing suit selfie and a caption that was hard to misinterpret: “20 weeks.” Now, they thought, her baby had finally arrived.
